description: Social comparison as a log-weighted evidence channel, SEPARATE from a resident's own incident history: relative_self_worth = domain_concept.state - peer_log_odds, where peer_log_odds is the SAME Laplace-smoothed log-odds formula LOGODDS_GENERATOR_PREREG.md already registered, applied to accumulated PeerObservation counts instead of Coactivation counts. Per the user's own diagnosis: 'you measure yourself by what you observe - this is a massive problem now in the social media era where you see the highlight reels of other people, so you feel less by comparison' (Chou & Edge 2012; Vogel et al. 2014) and 'your self worth can drop without dropping - if you assume the standard person is better - your self worth just dropped' (Stouffer et al. 1949, relative deprivation; Festinger 1954, social comparison). Zero real observations yields a genuinely neutral 0.0 fictional midpoint (the Laplace +1 IS 'making it up' when nothing real exists), not a hand-picked constant. Strictly additive over the CAN network's own Concept nodes -- can_native_reimplementation.json is NOT edited. See RELATIVE_SELF_WORTH_PREREG.md / _RESULTS.md.

concepts.name: relative_self_worth_via_social_comparison
concepts.definition: Felt self-worth is comparative, not absolute: it is one's own track record MINUS a log-odds baseline constructed from observations of others, which is itself constructed from nothing (a genuinely neutral, invented midpoint) when no real observations exist, and can become severely skewed when the observation channel itself is biased (social media's 'highlight reel' effect) -- moving the baseline moves felt self-worth even with zero change to one's own actual competence or track record.
concepts.why: User: three corrections in sequence -- weights must be log-scaled against a constructed (not hand-picked) midpoint, weighted to other real nodes (social comparison), and self-worth can drop purely from the comparison baseline shifting. RELATIVE_SELF_WORTH_PREREG.md.

rules.name: compute_relative_self_worth
rules.comment: PREREG Sec2: relative_self_worth = domain_concept.state - peer_log_odds, peer_log_odds computed via the SAME Laplace-smoothed formula LOGODDS_GENERATOR_PREREG.md already registered (ln((confirm+1)/(disconfirm+1))) -- zero observations yields a genuinely neutral 0.0 (Festinger's 'fictional midpoint', constructed via the Laplace +1 on each side, not asserted as a constant). A stable-fixpoint recompute (Not(Eq(stored, computed)) guard, mirroring can_native_update_3state's own idiom) -- refires whenever EITHER new peer observations arrive OR the domain Concept's own state changes (record_incident_outcome, unchanged), so self-worth genuinely can drop from a shifted comparison baseline with zero change to the resident's own track record (the user's own registered claim, PREREG Sec3 prediction 3). Zero new Rust -- Log/Div/Plus/Minus/Count/Filter/Neighbours/Attr/Var/Lit/Eq/Not all pre-existed.
